summary: Hard constraints contradict each other (CLOUD_VS_DEPLOYMENT); no compliant stack exists until one is relaxed.

warnings.message: cloud_preference=aws conflicts with deployment_model=on_premise: a public cloud cannot also be on-premise/air-gapped. Set cloud_preference to 'none' or pick a cloud deployment model.
Taking payments: use the gateway's hosted checkout/SDK so card data never touches your servers (PCI DSS SAQ A).
DPDP Act 2023: collect consent per purpose, honour erasure requests and report breaches; the Act itself does not force India-only storage unless data_residency requires it.
